claim: On the unopened forward Hyperliquid native-perp cross-section (2026-01-18..2026-04-30), a funding-conditioned score carries information about the RELATIVE ordering of next-24h observed liquidation intensity across coins (cross-sectional rank IC and top-minus-bottom spread), using the same estimand/inference as Arm B TRACKA-LIQ-XSEC-20261112T201536Z.

cannot: override, soften, or re-label any sealed time-series P2 verdict
status_contract.rationale: Forward window on an already-open region evaluated under a frozen exploratory prereg; estimand matches Arm B cross-sectional ranking, not a per-coin time-series design.

liquidations.access: unauthenticated HuggingFace bulk parquet via ironflow bulk cache (local, on-disk)

candles_1h.note: 2025-12 tail used only for 24h rv warm-up for the first scored day; 2025-11 and earlier never read.

universe.selection_rule: Coverage-only, frozen ex ante, before any outcome: native perps (market endswith '-PERP', no ':') with >=20 observed liquidation-days AND >=100 observed liquidation events over 2026-01-18..2026-04-30, AND complete hourly candle+funding coverage over the test window 2026-02-10..2026-04-30.
universe.selection_outcome_definition: Only label EXISTENCE/coverage counts are used for eligibility (event-adequacy rule). No liquidation magnitude, direction, timing, or forecast result informs selection.
universe.note: Final universe is 113 or fewer (coverage filter only), not ~150-190. No venue mixing.

targets.definition: Observed ironflow liquidation event count in the next 24h UTC bucket for that coin. Observed only; never modeled or synthetic.
Observed ironflow liquidation notional USD in the next 24h UTC bucket.

features_causal.rule: All features use only data at or before the bucket start. Hourly series are aggregated to the decision bucket with backward-looking as-of merges only.
features_causal.rv24h: Trailing 24h realized variance from hourly closes ending at bucket start
features_causal.funding_rate: Latest settled fundingRate at or before bucket start
features_causal.premium: Latest settled premium at or before bucket start
features_causal.score: Cross-sectional z-score of funding_rate plus cross-sectional z-score of abs_funding, computed WITHIN each 24h bucket across the eligible universe. No time-series fitting, no leakage across buckets.

estimand.primary: Spearman rank correlation between the cross-sectional funding score at bucket t and next-24h observed liquidation event count at t+1, per 30-day block on the pooled cross-section.
estimand.secondary: Top-k minus bottom-k mean next-24h liquidation notional spread (k = 10% of universe, floor 5), per block.
estimand.aggregation: Mean IC across blocks with permutation inference; the unit of inference is the 30-day block.

inference.null: Within each 24h bucket, permute the funding score across coins.
inference.materiality_floor: |mean IC| >= 0.05 AND top-minus-bottom spread sign consistent across >=2 of 3 blocks
inference.uncertainty: Report permutation null 5th/95th percentiles and empirical p-value per block and pooled.

splits.method: chronological, 7-day embargo between blocks, no random split

burn_in.role: Feature warm-up and eligibility context only; never scored

splits.note: Block end is the target horizon, not the last decision day. Builder scores start..end-1 day. Last decision day 2026-04-29 targets [2026-04-30, 2026-05-01) which is fully present. d=2026-04-30 would read May and is forbidden. Labels end 2026-04-30T23:48:51Z.

decision_rule.EXPLORATORY_SIGNAL: Materiality + permutation criteria met -> report as EXPLORATORY_ONLY signal with full diagnostics; never promoted
decision_rule.EXPLORATORY_NULL: Criteria not met -> preserve the null with exact failing minima
decision_rule.INADMISSIBLE: Universe < 5 coins or < 3 blocks with data -> emit infeasibility with exact minima and stop (do not weaken MIN_COINS)

forbidden: Any claim of promotion or confirmation
Reading or scoring 2026-05-01 or later (May 2026 and sealed windows)
Tuning score, k, or materiality floor against test blocks
Committing raw parquet objects or caches
Re-probing terminal Binance cells or sealed/Gate-4 paths
